arguments.text: Fixed. The bug was in tree.go's findCaseInsensitivePathRec: it descended into children[0] when a node had a wildcard child, but the wildcard child is always the LAST child (static children come first), so any case-insensitive lookup at such a node panicked with "invalid node type" (or, with a naive fix, failed to match static siblings). I made the wildcard branch use the last child and try the static children first, matching getValue's precedence. Verified: routes "/a/:b/c", "/a/d", "/a/e" now resolve "/A/X/C"->"/a/X/c" and "/A/D"->"/a/d" without panicking, and the whole test suite still passes.
Working on it: the errors.go / TestErrorUnwrap bug is being analyzed now (unwrapping interoperability of gin.Error). ETA ~6 minutes.
Working on it: the response_writer.go / TestResponseWriterStatusCode bug is being analyzed now (status-code handling in WriteHeader/Status). ETA ~6 minutes.
Working on it: the tree.go / TestRouteParamsNotEmpty bug is being analyzed now (params bookkeeping in getValue). ETA ~6 minutes.
Working on it: the context.go / TestContextNegotiationFormat2 bug (content negotiation) is being analyzed now. ETA ~6 minutes.
Working on it: the context.go / TestContextRenderAndEscapeAttachment bug (Content-Disposition escaping) is being analyzed now. ETA ~6 minutes.
